findings.where: Top nav, the "Destinations" link (desktop bar, and inside the Menu panel on phone)
findings.fault: The site's only link to hostels goes to #destinations, a section this page doesn't have. Clicking it does nothing visible: the page doesn't move and no destinations list appears. After reading how the ranking works, the visitor has no working way through to the hostels it ranks.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker who came here to check the ranking before choosing a hostel and now wants to see those hostels. On a phone mid-trip, a nav link that does nothing reads as a broken site, on a page whose whole job is to earn trust.

findings.where: Footer links "Privacy", "Terms" and "Report content" (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The parts map shows all three link back to this page. They look like links (white, underlined), but none reaches a privacy policy, terms or a way to report content. The header "MantaHostels home" wordmark also resolves to this page, though that may just be how this page was served.
findings.who_objects: A traveller deciding whether to trust Manta's scores, who checks the privacy policy or terms and lands back on the same page. Also a hostel owner or reviewer trying to flag a wrong listing or review, who finds the reporting route goes nowhere. Dead legal and reporting links on a 'trust us' page undercut what the page claims.
